name: Full width 184 mm (S)
description: Style measured from open-access research figures in evidence set S and the publisher's stated artwork requirements, at the stated full-page width of 184 mm. Changes typography, line weights, palette, legend and axis geometry only. Not an official template.

experimental.evidence_summary: 50 open-access papers; visual review of panels plus typeset-PDF measurements where available; official requirements audited 2026-09-16

derived_from.official_sources: Science instructions for preparing initial/revised manuscripts (science.org, Wayback captures 2025-08-10 / 2025-03-30): 5.7 / 12.1 / 18.4 cm widths, Helvetica preferred, not smaller than 5 pt and about 7 pt after reduction, lines >= 0.5 pt, 10 pt bold capital panel letters, >= 300 dpi; accessed 2026-09-16

experimental.width_source: OFFICIAL:Science instructions for preparing initial/revised manuscripts (science.org, Wayback captures 2025-08-10 / 2025-03-30)

value_evidence.grid: SHARED:Nature no grid 96%/Science no grid 94%/Cell no grid 96%
value_evidence.palette_name: SHARED:colour-blind-aware categorical palette; corpus modes Nature saturated 39%/Science mixed 40%/Cell saturated 32%; OFFICIAL: Nature figure guide requires an accessible palette
value_evidence.text_color: OBSERVED:axis and tick text black in the reviewed panels; publishers require standard fonts in black

value_evidence.marker_edge_width: ESTIMATED:0.4 pt - a visible but light edge; marker edges were 'dark' or 'none' in similar shares
value_evidence.grid_width: SHARED:grid is off; width kept light if a user turns it on
value_evidence.marker_size: ESTIMATED:corpus marker class 'small' (81% of coded panels) -> diameter about 0.8 x tick-label height -> 20.0 pt^2
value_evidence.marker_alpha: ESTIMATED:0.9 so overlapping observations remain distinguishable
value_evidence.errorbar_capsize: OBSERVED:modal error-bar style 'none'; short caps kept for legibility
value_evidence.legend_loc: OBSERVED:legends are most often absent or inside the axes (mode 'none')
value_evidence.legend_outside: OBSERVED:legends outside the axes are the minority; users move them per figure
value_evidence.formats: OFFICIAL:vector (PDF/EPS/AI) preferred by every publisher; PNG for review copies

notes: Science: absolute text sizes taken from the publisher's stated range, not measured
